youtube.title: What if an asteroid hit Los Angeles?
youtube.description:
A 140-meter asteroid nobody saw coming, 17 km per second, and you're stuck in L.A. traffic. ☄️🌴 From up here the whole city looks like a toy model – until the air hits.
Where would you have been? A) On the beach B) In the traffic C) Already in Vegas – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: NASA CNEOS (near-Earth objects ≥ 140 m), ESA (Chelyabinsk entry ~18 km/s), Britannica (impact event)
